preconditions.description: The number of red pixels is non-negative and less than or equal to 2^31 - 1.
The number of green pixels is non-negative and less than or equal to 2^31 - 1.
The number of blue pixels is non-negative and less than or equal to 2^31 - 1.
The total number of pixels is positive.

postconditions.description: The output is either -1 (if it's impossible to make all pixels the same color) or a non-negative integer less than or equal to 3 (the minimum number of fights needed to make the land peaceful and prosperous).
